## Items

### <a id="tec-001"></a>TEC-001 · Modular monolith (spec v0.3)

**Program** · ✅ Done · P0 · owner MisanaProger · progress 100 % (unestimated)

Rust workspace with dependencies pointing inwards (est-domain ← est-application ← adapters ← est-api/est-cli), ports in est-application, composition root in est-api/src/runtime.rs.

**Documentation:** [`docs/architecture.md`](../../docs/architecture.md), [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md)

**Source:** spec v0.3 §3–§22

#### <a id="tec-002"></a>TEC-002 · Layers and ports

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

est-domain has no SQLx/Axum/Git/LLM/Docker dependencies; every infrastructure capability is a port in est-application/src/ports.rs with an adapter crate.

- **Parent:** [TEC-001](#tec-001) Modular monolith (spec v0.3) (Done)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] est-domain depends only on est-core, serde, serde_json and thiserror
- [x] Adapters are wired only in est-api/src/runtime.rs

**Components:** [`crates/est-domain`](../../crates/est-domain), [`crates/est-application/src/ports.rs`](../../crates/est-application/src/ports.rs), [`crates/est-api/src/runtime.rs`](../../crates/est-api/src/runtime.rs)

#### <a id="tec-003"></a>TEC-003 · SQLite storage with append-only migrations

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

Repositories over SQLite with portable SQL; migrations 0001–0009.

- **Parent:** [TEC-001](#tec-001) Modular monolith (spec v0.3) (Done)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Migrations live in /migrations and are never edited once applied

**Components:** [`crates/est-storage`](../../crates/est-storage), [`migrations`](../../migrations)

#### <a id="tec-004"></a>TEC-004 · REST and WebSocket API with the local guard

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

Axum /api/v1 and /api/v1/events; the daemon trusts only its own Host and Origin; mutating endpoints take JSON.

- **Parent:** [TEC-001](#tec-001) Modular monolith (spec v0.3) (Done)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Requests with a foreign Host or Origin are refused
- [x] User-visible flows are covered in crates/est-api/tests/learning_loop.rs

**Components:** [`crates/est-api`](../../crates/est-api), [`crates/est-api/src/guard.rs`](../../crates/est-api/src/guard.rs), [`crates/est-api/tests/learning_loop.rs`](../../crates/est-api/tests/learning_loop.rs)

#### <a id="tec-005"></a>TEC-005 · AI Gateway

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI and Claude providers with presets, a switchable LlmSlot, streaming through ProseStream so code never reaches the client before the policy check.

- **Parent:** [TEC-001](#tec-001) Modular monolith (spec v0.3) (Done)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Providers switch without a restart and log ai.provider.changed without the key
- [x] Keys are stored outside config, events, logs and exports

**Components:** [`crates/est-ai`](../../crates/est-ai), [`crates/est-ai-policy/src/stream.rs`](../../crates/est-ai-policy/src/stream.rs), [`crates/est-application/src/streaming.rs`](../../crates/est-application/src/streaming.rs)

#### <a id="tec-006"></a>TEC-006 · Policy engine

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

Request classification, required level, one-step escalation, response constraints, tool permissions and external-action gates — all in code before a model is called.

- **Parent:** [TEC-001](#tec-001) Modular monolith (spec v0.3) (Done)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] A model cannot raise its own level or assume consent
- [x] The mentor (Initiator::Mentor) is refused every external action

**Components:** [`crates/est-ai-policy`](../../crates/est-ai-policy)

#### <a id="tec-007"></a>TEC-007 · Remote sources and the publish gate

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P1 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

RemoteSources port over HTTPS for GitHub, GitLab, Codeforces and LeetCode; reading needs per-request permission, publishing needs a confirmed draft with a digest.

- **Parent:** [TEC-001](#tec-001) Modular monolith (spec v0.3) (Done)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Reading without allow_network returns 403 and does not call the port
- [x] Publishing requires confirming the same digest within 15 minutes

**Components:** [`crates/est-remote`](../../crates/est-remote), [`crates/est-application/src/remote.rs`](../../crates/est-application/src/remote.rs), [`crates/est-ai-policy/src/gates.rs`](../../crates/est-ai-policy/src/gates.rs)

### <a id="tec-010"></a>TEC-010 · Assessment foundation

**Program** · ◯ Planned · P0 · owner MisanaProger · progress 0 % (unestimated)

Stored, traceable and reproducible assessment: an evidence ledger, provenance of every assessment, versioned scoring rules, the competency graph and the extended Issue lifecycle.

**Documentation:** [`docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md`](../../docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md), [`docs/decisions/ADR-0002-evidence-ledger.md`](../../docs/decisions/ADR-0002-evidence-ledger.md)

**Source:** TZ Phase 2

#### <a id="tec-011"></a>TEC-011 · Evidence ledger

**Epic** · ◯ Planned · P0 · release [REL-002](releases.md#rel-002) · owner MisanaProger · risk medium · progress 0 % (unestimated)

Today evidence is recomputed from lesson_results and session_summaries on every request (est-application/src/skills.rs) and only its latest form is visible. The ledger stores evidence records with all fields required by TZ 2.1, append-only, so an assessment can be explained and reproduced.

- **Parent:** [TEC-010](#tec-010) Assessment foundation (Planned)

**Documentation:** [`docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md`](../../docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md), [`docs/decisions/ADR-0002-evidence-ledger.md`](../../docs/decisions/ADR-0002-evidence-ledger.md)

**Source:** TZ 2.1

##### <a id="tec-012"></a>TEC-012 · Evidence record in the domain

**Feature** · ▶ Ready · P0 · owner MisanaProger

EvidenceRecord in est-domain: learner, Issue/lesson reference, skill reference, evidence type, observed_at, help level, check result, reliability, source context, rule version.

- **Parent:** [TEC-011](#tec-011) Evidence ledger (Planned)
- **Implements:** [LRN-014](learning.md#lrn-014) Help accounting per evidence (Ready)
- **Needed by:** [TEC-013](#tec-013) Evidence derivation from observed events (Planned), [TEC-014](#tec-014) Persistent evidence store (Planned), [TEC-050](#tec-050) Hint budget in the policy engine (Proposed)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] EvidenceRecord carries every field listed in TZ 2.1 and a rule version
- [ ] Evidence types are the seven of TZ 2.1 (LRN-012) as an enum, serialised in snake_case
- [ ] Help level is the highest engagement level used plus hint counts by stage
- [ ] Unit tests cover invariants: score 0–100, skill exists in the catalog version, observed_at not in the future

**Components:** [`crates/est-domain`](../../crates/est-domain)

**Documentation:** [`docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md#record`](../../docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md#record)

**Source:** TZ 2.1

##### <a id="tec-013"></a>TEC-013 · Evidence derivation from observed events

**Feature** · ◯ Planned · P0 · owner MisanaProger · risk medium

Pure rules turning a finished session, quiz attempt, artifact result or control task into evidence records — several per Issue, distinguishing independent from supported work.

- **Parent:** [TEC-011](#tec-011) Evidence ledger (Planned)
- **Depends on:** [TEC-012](#tec-012) Evidence record in the domain (Ready)
- **Implements:** [LRN-012](learning.md#lrn-012) Seven evidence types and their rules (Ready), [LRN-013](learning.md#lrn-013) Evidence reliability (Ready)
- **Needed by:** [TEC-015](#tec-015) Backfill evidence from existing data (Planned)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] One Issue can produce several records (per skill and per type)
- [ ] Independent and supported executions produce different types and reliabilities
- [ ] The same input always yields the same records (property test over shuffled event order)
- [ ] Derivation never calls a model and never reads the ADI

**Components:** [`crates/est-discipline`](../../crates/est-discipline)

##### <a id="tec-014"></a>TEC-014 · Persistent evidence store

**Feature** · ◯ Planned · P0 · owner MisanaProger · `debt`

Append-only table for evidence records (new migration), repository port and adapter; records are corrected by superseding records, never edited.

- **Parent:** [TEC-011](#tec-011) Evidence ledger (Planned)
- **Depends on:** [TEC-012](#tec-012) Evidence record in the domain (Ready)
- **Needed by:** [PRD-035](product.md#prd-035) Extended learning profile (Proposed), [TEC-015](#tec-015) Backfill evidence from existing data (Planned), [TEC-016](#tec-016) Assessment explanation API (Planned), [TEC-018](#tec-018) Provenance of assessments (Planned), [TEC-024](#tec-024) Gap queries (Planned), [TEC-031](#tec-031) Issue replay with history (Proposed), [TEC-047](#tec-047) Confidence records (Proposed), [TEC-048](#tec-048) Journal projection (Proposed), [TEC-051](#tec-051) Misconception detector (Proposed), [LRN-019](learning.md#lrn-019) Retention model (Proposed), [LRN-023](learning.md#lrn-023) Adaptive difficulty (Proposed), [INF-038](infrastructure.md#inf-038) Performance budgets (Proposed)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A new migration adds the evidence table; earlier migrations are untouched
- [ ] Records are never updated in place; a correction references the record it supersedes
- [ ] Deleting a conversation removes or anonymises its records as today's summaries are
- [ ] Records appear in the full data export

**Components:** [`crates/est-storage`](../../crates/est-storage), [`migrations`](../../migrations), [`crates/est-application/src/ports.rs`](../../crates/est-application/src/ports.rs)

##### <a id="tec-015"></a>TEC-015 · Backfill evidence from existing data

**Feature** · ◯ Planned · P0 · owner MisanaProger

On first start after the migration, existing lesson_results and session_summaries are converted to records with rule version `backfill-1` and reliability that marks missing fields.

- **Parent:** [TEC-011](#tec-011) Evidence ledger (Planned)
- **Depends on:** [TEC-013](#tec-013) Evidence derivation from observed events (Planned), [TEC-014](#tec-014) Persistent evidence store (Planned)

GET endpoints returning the records and the computation behind a skill's or discipline's assessment.

#### <a id="tec-017"></a>TEC-017 · Provenance and assessment versioning

##### <a id="tec-018"></a>TEC-018 · Provenance of assessments

**Feature** · ◯ Planned · P0 · owner MisanaProger

For each assessment: the triggering learner action (event ids), criteria version, the model involved (if any, only as explainer), evidence ids and the computation.

- **Parent:** [TEC-017](#tec-017) Provenance and assessment versioning (Planned)
- **Depends on:** [TEC-014](#tec-014) Persistent evidence store (Planned)
- **Needed by:** [PRD-045](product.md#prd-045) Structured progress export (Proposed), [TEC-016](#tec-016) Assessment explanation API (Planned), [TEC-019](#tec-019) Versioned scoring rules (Planned)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Every ADI assessment and Skill Matrix snapshot stores event ids, rule version and evidence ids
- [ ] A model's participation is recorded by provider/model name without secrets
- [ ] An assessment without provenance cannot be stored (domain invariant)

**Source:** TZ 4.4

##### <a id="tec-019"></a>TEC-019 · Versioned scoring rules

**Feature** · ◯ Planned · P0 · owner MisanaProger

A registry of rule versions (observed-0.2, esm-catalog-0.2, …) kept in code so an old assessment can be recomputed with its own version and compared with the current one.

- **Parent:** [TEC-017](#tec-017) Provenance and assessment versioning (Planned)
- **Depends on:** [TEC-018](#tec-018) Provenance of assessments (Planned)
- **Needed by:** [TEC-020](#tec-020) Reproducible task snapshots (Proposed)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Recomputing a stored assessment with its version returns the stored result (test)
- [ ] A version bump never silently changes stored assessments; re-scoring is an explicit, recorded action
